name: ltcai
description: Lattice AI — local-first Digital Brain Platform (knowledge graph, durable memory, hybrid search, agents, signed brain exchange)

scripts.build: npm run build:assets && npm run build:python
scripts.lint: node --check tests/visual/mock_server.cjs && node --check tests/visual/v3.spec.js && npm run lint:v3
scripts.release:artifacts: npm run build:assets && npm run build:python && npm pack && npm run package:vsix
scripts.publish:npm: npm pack && npm publish ltcai-$npm_package_version.tgz --access public
scripts.publish:pypi: npm run build:python && python3 -m twine upload --skip-existing dist/ltcai-$npm_package_version.tar.gz dist/ltcai-$npm_package_version-py3-none-any.whl
scripts.publish:vscode: cd vscode-extension && npm run package:vsix && npm run publish:vscode
scripts.publish:openvsx: cd vscode-extension && npm run package:vsix && npm run publish:openvsx
scripts.publish:all: npm run release:artifacts && npm run release:validate && npm publish ltcai-$npm_package_version.tgz --access public && python3 -m twine upload --skip-existing dist/ltcai-$npm_package_version.tar.gz dist/ltcai-$npm_package_version-py3-none-any.whl && cd vscode-extension && npm run publish:vscode && npm run publish:openvsx
